user.title: Navimower private-cloud login
user.description: Enter the email and password for the Navimow account used by Home Assistant. A dedicated shared account is recommended because signing into the mobile app with the same account can invalidate the private-cloud session. The password is used only for login and is not stored.

data_description.password: Used once to create or renew the private-cloud session.

select_vehicle.title: Choose a mower
select_vehicle.description: More than one mower was found on this private-cloud account.

manual.title: Enter the shared mower serial
manual.description: No mower was listed on this account. This is normal for some shared accounts. Enter the serial number shown in the Navimow app; Navimower validates it with a read-only cloud request.

link_oauth.title: Connect official live data
link_oauth.description: Continue to the official Navimow Smart Home authorization page. This second connection supplies the dense live MQTT route, heading and events. Navimower automatically falls back to private-cloud polling and repairs a stalled MQTT position stream without reloading the entities. The OAuth account must be able to access the same mower.

reauth_select.title: Repair Navimower authentication
reauth_select.description: Choose which independent connection should be renewed.

reauth_private.title: Reconnect Navimow private cloud
reauth_private.description: The private app-cloud session used for maps, settings, schedules and fallback mower data has expired. Live MQTT position may continue to work. Enter the password for the dedicated private-cloud account. The password is not stored.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Navimow cloud. Try again.
error.vehicle_not_found: That mower could not be read on this account. Check the serial and sharing permissions.
error.oauth_cannot_connect: The official Smart Home mower list could not be read.
error.oauth_mower_not_found: The OAuth account could not be matched to the selected private-cloud mower.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.oauth_cannot_connect: The official Smart Home mower list could not be read.
abort.oauth_mower_not_found: The OAuth account could not be matched to the selected private-cloud mower.
abort.unknown: The setup flow could not be completed.

init.title: Navimower options
init.description: Configure retained trail history, Navimower Schedule, zone-pair gates, virtual Custom Areas and optional legacy local X/Y gate areas.

general.title: General and trail history
general.description: Choose how long exact MQTT mowing sessions are retained in Home Assistant. Unlimited keeps every completed route and can increase Home Assistant storage and map payload size over time.

data_description.trail_retention_days: Completed session routes are stored locally. Shorter retention reduces storage and map loading time.
data_description.include_return_trail: Keep the mower route after cutting ends while it travels back to the dock.
data_description.diagnostics_detail: Extended includes endpoint freshness and MQTT recovery context in manual exports; tokens and account identifiers remain redacted.
data_description.passive_discovery: Temporarily subscribe to all MQTT downlink topics for this mower and retain bounded sanitized samples plus private-cloud response schemas in diagnostics. Enable only while investigating vendor notifications, camera or LiDAR features.

gates.title: Gates
gates.description: Add, edit or delete physical gates between mapped zones. Gate and channel safety uses only a fresh live MQTT position; stale fallback coordinates never close a gate.

gate_add.title: Add a gate
gate_add.description: Select the two mapped zones connected by this physical gate. With bidirectional enabled, either transition can request the gate. When disabled, the direction is Zone A to Zone B. Keep required after arrival delays the close signal by the selected number of seconds.

gate_edit.title: Edit gate
gate_edit.description: When bidirectional is disabled, the allowed direction is Zone A to Zone B. The close delay keeps the required signal active after the mower reaches the destination zone.

channels.title: Gate areas
channels.description: Add, edit or delete optional local-coordinate rectangles. Gate area state is available only while the MQTT position is fresh; private-cloud fallback is intentionally not used for physical gate safety.

channel_add.title: Add a gate area
channel_add.description: Channels are optional rectangular areas in the mower local X and Y coordinate system. They remain available alongside intention-based zone-pair gates and require a valid live MQTT position.

channel_edit_select.title: Choose a gate area to edit

navimower_schedule.title: Navimower Schedule
navimower_schedule.description:
Choose which proven zones the integration may mow automatically and when it may work. Only zones with at least one confirmed successful completion can be selected. A new or difficult zone must first be fully completed manually once; completing it does not select it automatically.

{unavailable_note}

data_description.navimower_schedule_zone_ids: The scheduler only dispatches zones selected here. New zones are never added automatically.
data_description.navimower_schedule_mode: Time window asks for daily start and end times on the next screen. 24 hours keeps the managed scheduler available continuously and starts a new round after every selected zone has completed.
data_description.navimower_schedule_order_mode: Automatic order selects the least recently completed selected zone first. Custom order keeps a persistent queue that can later be rearranged in Navimower Map Card.

navimower_schedule_window.title: Navimower Schedule — Time window
navimower_schedule_window.description: Set the daily time window during which Navimower Schedule may mow. Outside this window the managed scheduler returns the mower home and preserves unfinished work for the next window.

custom_areas.title: Custom areas
custom_areas.description: Create NaviMower-owned virtual polygon areas from a temporary off-limit area drawn in the Navimow app. Imported Custom Areas remain in Home Assistant after the temporary off-limit area is deleted.

custom_area_add.title: Add custom area
custom_area_add.description: Before continuing, make sure the temporary off-limit area does not exist in the Navimow map. Press Submit now to capture the current map as the baseline. Do not create the temporary off-limit area until the next step.

custom_area_detect.title: Create the temporary off-limit area
custom_area_detect.description: Baseline captured (map revision {baseline_revision}). Now open the Navimow app and Map editor, create exactly one new off-limit area in the shape of the Custom Area you want, and save the map. Leave that temporary off-limit area in place, return here, then press Submit. NaviMower will detect the new polygon automatically.

custom_area_name.title: Name the custom area
custom_area_name.description: New polygon detected: {area} m², {points} boundary points, centroid {centroid}. Give the area a name and press Submit to copy it into NaviMower. After it is saved, you can delete the temporary off-limit area from the Navimow app; the Custom Area will remain in Home Assistant.

custom_area_delete.title: Delete custom area
custom_area_delete.description: Delete only the NaviMower virtual Custom Area. This does not change the robot map or any Navimow off-limit area.

error.same_zone: Zone A and Zone B must be different.
error.duplicate_gate: A gate with the same name or zone pair already exists.
error.duplicate_channel: A channel with the same name already exists.
error.schedule_same_time: Start and end must be different when Allowed mowing time is Time window.
error.custom_area_map_not_available: The current Navimow map is not loaded yet. Wait for the integration to refresh and try again.
error.custom_area_refresh_failed: The Navimow map could not be refreshed. Try again.
error.custom_area_not_detected: No new off-limit polygon was detected. Make sure you created exactly one new off-limit area in the Navimow app and saved the map, then try again.
error.custom_area_multiple_detected: More than one new off-limit polygon was detected. Keep only the single temporary area you want to import, save the map, and try again.
error.custom_area_invalid: The detected polygon or Custom Area name is invalid.
error.custom_area_duplicate: A Custom Area with the same name already exists.

abort.options_saved: Navimower options were saved and the integration is reloading.
abort.zones_not_available: At least two mapped zones must be loaded before a gate can be configured.
